title: Supergateway config
description: A --config file: servers under "mcpServers", as MCP clients write them, and any option of the command line.

port.description: The port to listen on. Default: 8000.

host.description: The address to listen on. Default: every interface.

logFormat.description: Log lines as text (default) or one JSON object per line.

exitWithProcess.description: Shut down when the process with this PID exits.

healthEndpoint.description: Paths that answer "ok". At the top level they are the gateway's own; on a server they are under its path.

outputTransport.description: How the server is served. Default: sse for a local server, stdio for a url one.

baseUrl.description: The public base URL clients reach an SSE server at.

ssePath.description: Path of the SSE stream. Default: /sse.

messagePath.description: Path for SSE and WebSocket messages. Default: /message.

cors.description: true allows every origin; a list allows those origins ("/regex/" for a pattern).

healthCheck.description: What the health endpoints check: the gateway alone (default), or the MCP server too.

toolPrefix.description: Put before every tool name the server lists, e.g. "github_".

tools.description: Expose only these tools, by the server's own names. An empty list exposes none.

apiKey.description: Keys a client must present, as Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-API-Key.

apiKeyFile.description: A file of accepted keys, one per line.

sessionTimeout.description: Milliseconds an idle stateful session is kept.

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version the gateway initializes a server with, in stateless Streamable HTTP, when the client names none.

headers.description: For a local server, headers on the gateway's responses; for a url server, headers sent to it.

mcpServers.description: The servers, by name. Each is served at /<name>.

autoApprove.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

alwaysAllow.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

timeout.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

trust.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

alwaysLoad.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

disabledTools.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

includeTools.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

excludeTools.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

envFile.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

headersHelper.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

oauth.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

description.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

globalShortcut.description: Used by other MCP clients. Supergateway ignores it.

command.description: The program to run, without a shell. Goes with "args".

stdio.description: A shell command line that runs the server, as --stdio.

type.description: How to reach a url server: "sse" or "http" (Streamable HTTP). "stdio" for a local one, or nothing.

transportType.description: The same as "type", as some clients write it.
